entities.name: Aristotelis Valaoritis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aristotelis Valaoritis was a Greek poet, representative of the Heptanese School, and politician. He was also the great-grandfather of Nanos Valaoritis, one of the most distinguished writers of Greece.
